sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Test setup and cleanup
sections.what: Imports the test tools and the components and services under test. Before each test, clears the imported rows for two demo cases. After each test, resets the test database.
sections.why: Makes each test start from a clean state so results do not depend on the order of tests.
sections.watch_out: The cleanup only removes rows for the two demo IDs, so a new demo case must be added to the list here.

sections.name: Documents imported-record context
sections.title: Imported record tests
sections.what: Checks the empty state text, the synthetic record fields such as khata, khesra, area and provenance, and that imports stay within the case. Also checks that the ordinary document list is unchanged after an import.
sections.why: Protects the rule that imported records are kept apart from real documents and from other cases.
sections.watch_out: The expected values, such as the record number and area, are fixed. A change to the fixture data will break these checks.

summary: Tests the imported official record display and checks that imported records stay separate from ordinary documents.
purpose: Confirms the display shows a useful empty state and the right synthetic record fields, and that imports do not leak into other cases or the document list.
why: Likely reason: imported records are synthetic and must not change the real document list. Reason partly stated in the test names.
how: Before each test, clears the imported record rows for two demo cases in the test database. Then runs three tests. One checks the empty state text. One imports a synthetic record and checks its fields and text. One checks the import is limited to one case and that the document list is unchanged. After all tests, resets the test database.
inputs: The test database, the official record service, the document service, and the display component.
outputs: Pass or fail results for each test.
risks: The tests change the test database, so they must not run against real data. A change to the record fields will break several checks.
debug: If a test fails, check the database clearing step first, then the fixture ID used for import. If the text checks fail, check the translation strings.
